svg.text: Find the area between a line and a curve
Marlbridge • OxfordAQA International A-level Mathematics 9660 • Area between a line and a curve, or two curves
Area between curves is the integral of upper minus lower
Worked example 8 • y = x² − x + 1 and y = 2x + 11
